Up. 2. 1. 14</ls>; कथं नु गुणवद्विन्देयं कलत्रम् <ls>Dk.</ls>; see किंनु also. .²3 <ab>Ved.</ab> Now, even now. .²4 Now therefore, now then, therefore. .²5 Like, as. .²6 Quickly. .²7 From this time forward. also ({@नू@}) <ab>Ved.</ab> Alone; नू मर्तो दयते सनिष्यन् <ls>Rv. 7. 100. 1</ls>.
